game.title: Avatar Frontiers of Pandora Complete Edition

metadata.description: Includes the main game, the season pass, cosmetics, bonus content, the digital artbook, and the From the Ashes expansion. In Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™, experience the never-before-seen Western Frontier. Abducted by the RDA, you, a Na’vi, were trained and molded to serve their purpose. Fifteen years later, you are free but find yourself a stranger in your birthplace. Become Na'vi and reconnect with your ancestral heritage in a fight for freedom against the RDA. - Experience the epic and unpredictable Western Frontier in an open world adventure. - Become a Na'vi and customize your character, craft gear, and upgrade skills and weapons to fit your playstyle. - Bond with your own banshee to travel or give you an edge in aerial combat. - Master multiple combat styles, embracing traditional Na’vi or destructive human weapons. - Play the full story campaign in single-player or with a friend online in two-player co-op. In the From the Ashes expansion, play as So’lek, a Na’vi warrior who has found solace with the Sarentu. Just as peace settles over the Western Frontier, a new threat rises: the RDA, now allied with the Ash clan, who are ruthless Na’vi bent on annihilation. Ambushed and left for dead, So’lek awakens to a scorched land and his newfound family scattered. With new third-person gameplay, embark on So’lek’s journey as he vows to find his family and exact revenge on those who wronged him. - Experience this journey designed for third-person gameplay, which remains playable in first person at your choice. - Enjoy a streamlined progression system, enhanced combat and stealth gameplay, and brutal takedown finishers. - Face the Ash clan in combat and epic boss fights. - Navigate a world ravaged by destruction and flames. Internet connection, Ubisoft Account, PlayStation™Network account, and PlayStation®Plus subscription (sold separately) required to access online multiplayer/features.
